description: Golden question set for the Altostrat Singapore HR policy RAG. Every `expect_paths` entry was verified to exist in the corpus at authoring time. `expect` selects the required outcome: `answer` (retrieval must surface the listed path), `escalate` (the corpus datasheet forbids answering - a Conflict section, extended-workforce leave, or a placeholder contact), or `refuse` (nothing in the corpus can support an answer, so the gate must reject).
